# David Vilela

> Full stack developer and UI/UX designer based in Vila Real, Portugal. Twenty-three,
> writing code since 2016 and working in development since 2023. Portuguese and English,
> both fluent. Works end to end: interface design, frontend, API layer and database.

This site is a personal portfolio rendered as a black-and-white desktop environment.
Each section opens as a draggable window. It sets no cookies, runs no analytics and
loads no third-party scripts.

## Stack

- Frontend: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Vue, Angular
- Backend: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, .NET
- Languages: TypeScript (primary), JavaScript, SQL, C#
- API: REST, GraphQL
- Design: Figma, FigJam, Illustrator, Notion
- Tools: VSCode, GitHub, Docker, Vercel, Render, DigitalOcean, AWS S3, Cloudflare, Azure, Redis Cloud, Railway PostgreSQL

## Pages

- [English](/en): full portfolio — about, experience, projects, skills, background, legal.
- [Português (PT-PT)](/pt): the same content in European Portuguese.
